description: rnews.rs:5-6 and throughout — The module doc lists UUCP-G1 and UUCP-G3 as security invariant labels, and the code also references UUCP-G4. UUCP-G2 is never mentioned anywhere in the codebase or docs. A reader has no idea: (a) what the full UUCP-G* threat-model numbering scheme is, (b) what UUCP-G2 was (deleted? not applicable?), (c) where to find the authoritative list. The threat_model.md doc has no mention of UUCP. Fix: add a brief UUCP threat-model table to docs/threat_model.md or docs/adr/, defining G1–G4 (and noting any gaps), and link to it from the rnews.rs module doc comment.
title: UUCP-G* labels undefined: G2 missing, no threat model table
